# Verification inventory

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p bc_inventory`; do not edit. `cargo run -p bc_inventory -- --check` fails when it is out of date. -->

Every production function of the workspace and the examples belongs to one tier; this page counts them and lists each one outside Verus (functions generated by macro invocations are not seen). Verus is used wherever it can be; a function it cannot verify is covered by a Kani harness if possible, otherwise by tests run under Miri; an entry point that none of them can run is a branch-free shim, run by an integration test. A function outside Verus carries a `// coverage:` comment naming what covers it and why a higher tier cannot (`why:` `dyn`, `fmt`, `string`, `ffi`, `io`, `signal`, `hw`, `bindgen`, `build`, `boundary`, `trait`). The rules are `spec fn`s in `crates/bc_inventory/src/rules.rs`, verified by Verus; tests, Kani harnesses, the executable specification and this tool's reader and writer are verification tools and are only counted. `--check` enforces the rules for the engine, the specification, this tool and the front ends already brought into the tiers (`bc_clone`, `bc_c_api`, `bc_zephyr`, `bc_qemu_riscv32`, `bc_build_info`, `m5stamp_c3_bc`); the other front ends' violations are listed below until each one is brought into the tiers.

| Tier | What it establishes |
|---|---|
| Verus | The function meets its contract for all inputs (partial correctness where marked); with no `ensures`, that it cannot panic or overflow |
| assumed | Verus takes it as true: an axiom, a trusted wrapper or a model; kept in `trusted*` files, and a wrapper's body is run by a test |
| Kani | No panic, overflow or failed assertion for the symbolic inputs of the harness, within its bounds |
| Miri | No undefined behavior or leak on the paths the tests run; functional correctness only as far as the tests assert |
| shim | No branch (checked by this tool; a `loop` without `break`, which only halts, is not one); run by the named integration test |
